messages:
Jordan Kim: Kicking off AetherGrid AG-X preview sprint. NDA executed this morning. Partner wants a lightweight preview listing, SI onboarding notes, and an embargo plan. Need bench matrix and telemetry plan by Tue.
Priya Rao: Noted. Can partner provide firmware+images by Mon so we can validate driver compatibility and our KV cache behavior?
Evan Cho: I'll scope a compact harness: smoke correctness, multi-context throughput, and a 2-hour sustained QPS soak to look for thermal throttling. Proposed preview gates: rwd-13b p50 < 72ms p95 < 260ms @8k; capture cold-start p95 separately.
Legal Bot: NDA status: signed. Partner requested a 7-day mutual embargo post-internal signoff. Flag: partner logos require trademark approval before listing.
Jordan Kim: Marketplace Team, can you draft a "preview access" listing and hold on any GA language. Partner wants a co-branded badge but legal clearance is required.
Marketplace Team: Will draft. Please send screenshots and a sanitized console mock. We'll avoid pricing and GA claims.
Evan Cho: Bench matrix: models=[rwd-13b,rwd-70b], ctx=[4k,8k,32k], modes=[fp16,quant8]. Also include cold-start runs and sustained QPS sweeps at 50%, 75%, 100% of baseline QPS.
Priya Rao: SI note: AetherGrid's SI, Orion Systems, asked for a sample helm chart and terraform snippet to validate our private deployment flow. Can we share a sanitized example (no secrets)?
LabOps: We can provide a sanitized helm + tf sample. Reserve bench slots: Wed 22:00-02:00 UTC and Thu 03:00-07:00 UTC. Please upload configs to https://drive.redwood/apps/aethergrid/eap-configs. Job queued: AGX-EAP-8801. Logs will be in /runs/AGX-EAP-8801.
Evan Cho: Dev command for harness: `./bench_run --target aether-agx --model rwd-13b --ctx 8192 --mode fp16 --warmup 700 --samples 180 --cold-start`
Jordan Kim: Telemetry plan: token-sampling 0.5%, prefix cache hit/miss, per-request cold marker, anonymize prompts prior to export. Also emit board temp + fan speed to correlate throttling. Legal Bot: telemetry plan OK if prompts are stripped.
Priya Rao: Runtime changes: add a fallback path `aether-agx-quant` and a thermal-triggered throttle policy that reduces sustained QPS on heat events. Evan, can you add a small runtime snippet?
Evan Cho: Runtime snippet to add: `{"fallback":"aether-quant","thermal_policy":"gradual_backoff","metrics_tag":"aether-agx-eap"}`. I'll push a branch `feat/aether-eap-fallback`.
LabOps: Note: include sensor logs in artifacts. We'll attach flamegraphs, heatmaps, and raw env sensor output.
Marketplace Team: For the listing assets, partner supplied logos; Legal Bot please confirm trademark usage once we upload. Also need a short co-author blurb for the blog.
Legal Bot: Will review trademarks after assets are uploaded. Also confirm embargo window before any external communications.
Jordan Kim: Action items: Evan push harness + runtime fallback (Due: Mon EOD), LabOps run benches and upload artifacts (Due: Thu EOD), Marketplace prepare preview draft + mock screenshots (Due: Thu). Quick sync Mon 10:00 PT to confirm images.
deploy-bot: bench job queued: job_id=AGX-EAP-8801, eta Wed 22:00 UTC. Artifacts will appear under /runs/AGX-EAP-8801.
Priya Rao: Thanks team 680. If images/firmware delayed, flag here so we can escalate to partner EM. Also follow the trademark checklist before publishing any asset.
